sonnet.problem: The question says the edges of the field and the fallen grapes are both left for the poor and the foreigner. Verse 10 only says to leave the fallen grapes and the vineyard's leftovers ('Leave them'). It never says the field edges from verse 9 go to the poor and foreigner, so the card connects two things the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
